pr_body:
Fixes #42070 

When deserialization continues with a new chunk of data in the middle of a null token, a `JsonException` is thrown.
This PR attempts to fix this issue.

I verified that the change fixes the [original repro](https://github.com/frankbuckley/net5-json-repro).
I also verified that the two test cases (but with payload just beneath 2GB) mentioned by @am11 in this [comment](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/42070#issuecomment-691087902) work as expected with the changes in this PR.

The risk of regressions is low. Only continuation situations at null tokens are affected that throw or result in unexpected null values without the change.

To do this reliably, the [`.RuleFor(a => a.Province, f => f.Address.State().OrNull(f, 0.7f))`](https://github.com/frankbuckley/net5-json-repro/blob/b5c3990a99d018bf2e8a7c51aee5f98305f53fc2/Program.cs#L59) seems to be required (at least, I have not yet seen the error without it).

This happens, when the buffered data ends exactly while reading a null token. 
When the next block of data is available, the state continuation mechanism stops (after entering the first frame) at this condition in `JsonPropertyInfo<T>.ReadJsonAndSetMember()` which I think should also include `state.IsContinuation`
```c#
237                if (!isNullToken || !IgnoreDefaultValuesOnRead || !Converter.CanBeNull)
```
Will try to fix it without regression or at least add a simple repro.

review_comments: nit: let's call this `StreamTests.cs` to handle roundtrip stream cases since we already have `Stream.*Tests.cs`.

Since we have other code paths to allow "partial progress"/continuation via the `Utf8JsonReader` overload, something a bit more generic as the filename that covers more uses, might actually be better than using `StreamTests`. 

Something like `ContinuationTests` seems reasonable, but **only** if it makes sense to add test cases for other overloads to this file too. See https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/42158#discussion_r488907272

I already completely refactored this for the same reason. Follow up PR is coming soon.
